render_nerf_pose: render a NeRF scene from a camera pose using render_pose with model params and render config
render_nerf_rays: render rays through a NeRF model using render_rays to produce rgb and depth maps
compute_volumetric_rendering: compute volumetric rendering from rgb values, density, z_vals, and ray directions using volumetric_rendering
generate_camera_rays: generate ray origins and directions from a camera pose using get_rays with height, width, and focal length
batch_generate_camera_rays: batch generate rays for multiple camera poses using get_rays_batch via jax vmap over the pose dimension
